searchText: Does etherscan usually take that long to index blocks on ropsten ? I have submitted transactions 4 hours ago to infura node and they are still waiting to be indexed in etherscan. Etherscan is 2069 blocks behind the block count I'm getting from infura Something seems strange. I just submitted another transaction and it was just mined and showed up in block 10682374 in etherscan. But if I inquire rposten infura it shows up in block 10684459 <@!805883631498297394> https://faucet.ropsten.be/ okay so it seems this channel is for off-topic stuff related to eth r&d...does anyone know a server where we can discuss more "application layer" level stuff like blockchain applications & such Anyone got an Etherscan API key? Oh you can try https://discord.gg/e3fAw8Cx
